children: Taiwan's Taiex falls back into the bear market as the chip selloff continues. The benchmark index plunges 7.3% after rallying 9.0% in the previous session thanks to Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO. The Taiex is more than 25% below the peak reached on Oct. 6. Taiwan stocks have been volatile in recent sessions, sliding into bear-market territory on AI demand concerns and the Nvidia saga, only to bounce back sharply on government support and relief rallies. The index's overwhelming tech concentration and exposure to the AI trade make it highly sensitive to recent headlines. Shares of TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, tumble 8.3% and Foxconn Technology Group, which builds AI servers for Nvidia, slides 9.9%. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
